title: Microsoft reports Q4 Azure and other cloud services revenue up 43% YoY, vs. 40% est., and says Azure revenue in FY 2026 exceeded $100B for the first time (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary: Jordan Novet / CNBC: Microsoft reports Q4 Azure and other cloud services revenue up 43% YoY, vs. 40% est., and says Azure revenue in FY 2026 exceeded $100B for the first time — Microsoft shares rose in extended trading on Wednesday after the software maker disclosed strong fiscal fourth-quarter revenue.
